title: Use of Machine Learning to Predict the Incidence of Type 2 Diabetes Among Relatively Healthy Adults: A 10-Year Longitudinal Study in Taiwan
summary: A decade-long Taiwanese cohort evaluates machine-learning prediction of incident type-two diabetes. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.

evidence.tested: A decade-long Taiwanese cohort evaluates machine-learning prediction of incident type-two diabetes.
evidence.unknown: No prospective clinical benefit or broader external validity is established by the documented study.
evidence.ai_role: A decade-long Taiwanese cohort evaluates machine-learning prediction of incident type-two diabetes.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
